I run my pontos with Cassiah, if you have pilots and guants and glands in your deck you probably are gonna want the additional draw and discard she provides.
When you use her Exalt while an Embryo is in your Hand, she Devours (or Consumes) it to apply Petrify, which essentially Stuns Targets, each Target can also be petrified once each

She also excels really well at applying Vulnerable via A Small Wish (1-Cost) and her Rouse which makes it so that each time she plays a Card she also applies Vulnerable, and a neat trick that you could do with Decomposition (3-Cost) is that if you use it on a Target w/ Vulnerable, she Draws a Card and refunds the Arith spent
